component: private Brotli B3a workspace, meta-block, and complete code-description components
status: checked B3a components; not a complete decoder or supported API
claim: The checked private B3a components implement the exact fixed workspace and builder layout, exact framed initialized access, RFC meta-block headers, every simple description, the complex auxiliary alphabet with width-limited transmitted-code reversal, RFC repeat-coded final symbol lengths with exact 32,768-unit accounting, and canonical installation into the selected workspace tree with exact per-record and frame guarantees.

compiled_artifact.note: Ordinary Cargo release library from the same annotated source; compiler remains trusted.

workspace: exact (1 << max_window_bits) + 1,176,560 byte requirement for bits 10..24
all approved region offsets, sizes and total are checked
tree/symbol addressing stays inside its selected three-byte-record region
successful record writes produce the exact length and little-endian code bytes while preserving every other workspace byte
initialized reads reconstruct exactly those record bytes
canonical reads require an initialized prefix
single-symbol zero-bit reads do not inspect old workspace bytes
the 3,056-byte builder has exact code-length, count, next-code, symbol-chain and temporary-tree subregions
builder reads require initialized entries and builder writes have exact byte frames
canonical installation proves every selected tree record equals the original builder length and exact canonical code
unused zero-length canonical records contain code zero while remaining distinct from single-symbol zero-bit metadata
canonical installation preserves every byte outside builder bookkeeping and the selected destination tree
meta_block_header: each transition equals the specified transition for the exact consumed bits
reserved and nonminimal encodings are permanent errors
complete and failed states are sticky
code_description_front_end: every transition equals the specified transition for the exact consumed bits
all simple one-to-four-symbol descriptions, alphabet widths, bounds, distinctness and shape bits
RFC 18-entry code-length permutation and all six static-prefix values
permanent duplicate, alphabet, incomplete, oversubscribed and truncation errors
initial previous code length eight and exact direct-length previous-value updates
RFC repeat-16/two-bit and repeat-17/three-bit semantics with reset and chained recurrence
exact emitted span bounds and rejection beyond the selected alphabet
exact 32,768-unit final code-space charging and completion
whole-buffer and one-byte chunk equivalence cases, final truncation and sticky permanent failures
width-limited reversal connects natural auxiliary canonical codes to the raw least-significant-bit-first stream

limitations: The checked final-length spans and canonical installer remain separate private components until B3b tree-group orchestration connects the handoff.
No tree groups, context maps, literal/command/distance execution, LZ77, dictionary, output, budgeted public decoder, or B4 caller is implemented.
No PP-Security profile is adopted and independent specification review remains pending.
Rust/LLVM, modeled library operations, verifier/solver, OS and hardware remain trusted.
